title.tc: 貨物的合併與申報責任
title.en: Cargo aggregation and declaration responsibility

points.tc: 非承運人：合併同一人以同一跨境運輸工具輸入／輸出的現金類物品。承運人：合併同一承運人為同一客戶在同一運輸工具運送的物品；客戶須直接聘用承運人，或直接聘用把物品交給承運人的代運人。同一客戶聘用多名代運人時，只有同一代運人交予同一承運人的物品才按這項規則合併。客戶指非承運人，不能把物流代運人自行當成客戶。
points.en: For a non-carrier, aggregate CBNIs imported/exported on the same carrier for the same customer. For a carrier, aggregate consignments for the same customer on that conveyance; where multiple consignors use the same freight forwarder, section 10 treats the forwarder as customer. Splitting consignments does not defeat aggregation.

points.tc: 輸入、輸出或安排輸入／輸出的人須確保事前已有合規申報；僅掌管運輸工具而無其他輸入／輸出責任者有第9(2)條例外。通常以電子方式申報；獲系統接納及編配參考編號才算完成。關長認為電子傳送並非切實可行時，可依關長指示採另一方式；不是自行改用任意紙本程序。旅客、郵包及法定過境／航空轉運貨物豁除另按第8條判斷。
points.en: A person importing/exporting or causing import/export must ensure a compliant declaration has been made beforehand; section 9(2) excepts a conveyance operator with no other responsibility for the import/export. Normally declare electronically; acceptance and allocation of a reference number complete submission. Where the CCE considers electronic transmission impracticable, use an alternative manner directed by the CCE, not an arbitrary paper route. Apply section 8 exclusions for travellers, postal packets and the specified transit/air-transhipment cargo separately.

title.tc: 理解：2022年報告中的公司及戶口濫用
title.en: Understand: company and account misuse in the 2022 report

points.tc: 空殼公司（shell company）可沒有實質營運而被用作隱藏擁有人或轉款；掛名公司（front company）則以貌似或實際合法業務及收支掩飾犯罪得益。2022年報告提到單一股東／董事、與香港無關連、業務含糊及資金頻繁大額進出而結餘低的組合警號；單一特徵不等於犯罪。
points.en: A shell company may lack substantive operations and be used to hide ownership or move funds. A front company uses apparently or actually legitimate business and receipts/payments to disguise criminal proceeds. The 2022 report describes combinations of sole ownership/directorship, no Hong Kong nexus, vague business and frequent large flows with low balances; no single feature proves crime.

points.tc: 錢騾／傀儡戶口（money mule／stooge account）：由他人名義持有或控制、被用來接收及轉移犯罪得益的戶口；應留意持有人是否真正控制及了解交易。報告所述高速收轉款、小額試轉及更換戶口／裝置等，是需要與客戶背景一起評估的手法。
points.en: Money-mule or stooge accounts are accounts in other persons’ names or control used to receive and move criminal proceeds. Examine whether the holder genuinely controls and understands the activity. Rapid receipt and dissipation, small test transfers and changing accounts/devices described in the report need assessment alongside the customer profile.

points.tc: 挪用現金補空（cash kiting，循環轉款）：在同一方控制的多個個人／公司之間循環轉款，虛增營業額或薪酬以取得未獲授權的額外貸款／信貸。最初循環的款項未必是犯罪得益，但藉此取得的欺詐貸款可以是；不是每個循環轉帳都自動構成這種手法。
points.en: Cash kiting circulates funds among individuals/entities under common control to inflate turnover or payroll and obtain unauthorized additional loans/credit. The initial circulating money need not be criminal proceeds; the fraudulently generated loan can be. Not every circular transfer automatically constitutes this method.

title.tc: 2022年PF評估範圍與PACE
title.en: The 2022 PF assessment and PACE

points.tc: 就報告引用的FATF第1項建議而言，PF風險嚴格限於可能違反、沒有實施或逃避第7項建議的針對性財政制裁（TFS）責任。這個評估範圍與更廣的擴散活動概念須分開；不能只找「資金直接購買武器」，而漏看代名人、受控公司或制裁規避。
points.en: For FATF Recommendation 1 as discussed in the report, PF risk refers strictly to potential breach, non-implementation or evasion of the targeted financial sanctions (TFS) obligations in Recommendation 7. Distinguish this assessment scope from the broader proliferation concept; focusing only on direct weapon purchases can miss nominees, controlled entities or sanctions evasion.

points.tc: PACE是報告列明的四項策略，沒有先後流程：Prevention預防——法律制度、培訓及認識責任；Alert警報——及時傳遞制裁更新；Coordination協調——跨部門及監管合作、情報分享；Enforcement執法——調查及監督遵從。須記名稱並理解各自作用；不把2022年當時的制裁名單數字當作現況。
points.en: PACE names four strategy elements, not sequential steps: Prevention—legal controls, training and awareness; Alert—timely sanctions updates; Coordination—inter-agency/regulatory cooperation and intelligence sharing; Enforcement—investigation and compliance supervision. Recognize the names and purposes; the report’s 2022 sanctions-list counts are not current facts.

title.tc: 本地轉帳的範圍及兩層資料要求
title.en: Domestic scope and two levels of information requirements

points.tc: 「本地」不只看發款人和受款人在哪裏：匯款機構、收款機構，以及每一間中介機構，都必須是位於香港、符合AMLO定義的金融機構。只要鏈中有境外中介機構，就不符合這項本地電傳定義。
points.en: “Domestic” is not determined merely by the originator’s and recipient’s locations. The ordering institution, beneficiary institution and every intermediary must be financial institutions as defined by AMLO located in Hong Kong. An overseas intermediary takes the chain outside this domestic-wire definition.

points.tc: 條例附表2第12(6)及(9)條：本地轉帳可隨附發款人戶口／獨特參考號碼；收款機構須追索缺漏的該號碼。第03份指引第10.11–10.12段只簡化發款人資料，並未免除所需受款人資料；第10.20段要求收款機構追索本地或跨境轉帳缺漏的所需雙方資料。兩層要求須分開認識，不能把較窄的法例文字當作可忽略指引的理由。
points.en: Schedule 2 sections 12(6) and (9) permit the originator account/unique reference number to accompany a domestic wire and require the beneficiary institution to obtain that number if missing. Document 03 paragraphs 10.11–10.12 simplify originator information, without exempting required recipient information; paragraph 10.20 requires the beneficiary institution to obtain missing required information on either side for domestic or cross-border wires. Recognise both levels: the narrower statutory wording does not justify ignoring the Guideline.

title.tc: 不遵從查察／調查要求的三層刑責
title.en: Three offence levels for inspection/investigation requirements

points.tc: 第10及13條針對被施加相應法定要求的人：無合理辯解不遵從，循公訴最高20萬元及1年；循簡易程序最高第5級罰款及6個月。
points.en: Sections 10 and 13 concern persons subject to the corresponding statutory requirements. Failure to comply without reasonable excuse: on indictment, up to HK$200,000 and one year; summarily, a level 5 fine and six months.

points.tc: 充作遵從要求而提供在要項上虛假或誤導的紀錄／回答等，並且明知或罔顧實情：循公訴最高100萬元及2年；循簡易程序最高第6級罰款及6個月。
points.en: Purported compliance by supplying materially false/misleading records, answers or other specified information, knowingly or recklessly: on indictment, up to HK$1 million and two years; summarily, a level 6 fine and six months.

points.tc: 出於詐騙意圖而不遵從或提供虛假／誤導資料，或相關人士出於詐騙意圖致使／容許義務人如此行事：循公訴最高100萬元及7年；循簡易程序最高第6級罰款及6個月。相關人士包括僱員、受僱為其工作者及參與管理者。這裏的簡易程序刑罰不同於第5條詐騙罪的50萬元及1年。第10(10)及13(10)條另限制就同一行為重複提起刑事與第14條程序。
points.en: Intent-to-defraud non-compliance or provision of false/misleading information, including a related person fraudulently causing/permitting the obligated person’s conduct: on indictment, up to HK$1 million and seven years; summarily, a level 6 fine and six months. Related persons include employees, persons employed to work for the obligated person and management. This summary penalty differs from the HK$500,000/one-year section 5 fraud penalty. Sections 10(10) and 13(10) also restrict duplicate criminal and section 14 proceedings for the same conduct.

title.en: Reference: Part 5A trust or company service providers (TCSPs)

points.tc: 信託或公司服務指在香港以業務形式向他人提供一項或以上：成立法團／其他法人；擔任或安排他人擔任董事、秘書、合夥人或其他法人類似職位；向法人／法律安排提供註冊辦事處、營業、通訊或行政地址；擔任或安排他人擔任明示信託／類似法律安排的受託人，或代名股東（不包括證券於認可證券市場上市的法團的代名股東）。第5A部由公司註冊處處長執行。第53B條豁除政府、認可機構、以該業務附屬於主要業務的持牌法團、會計及法律專業人士和訂明類別；豁除本部不等於豁除其他適用AML責任。
points.en: Trust or company service means providing, in Hong Kong by way of business to others, one or more of: formation of corporations/other legal persons; acting or arranging directors, secretaries, partners or similar positions for legal persons; registered, business, correspondence or administrative addresses for legal persons/arrangements; acting or arranging trustees of express trusts/similar arrangements or nominee shareholders, excluding nominees for corporations listed on a recognized stock market. Part 5A is administered by the Registrar of Companies. Section 53B excludes government, authorized institutions, licensed corporations whose TCSP business is ancillary to their principal business, accounting/legal professionals and prescribed classes; exclusion from this Part is not exclusion from other applicable AML duties.

points.tc: 一般牌照及續期為3年，處長可在個案訂較短期間；續期須在到期前至少60日提出。及時申請後仍待決時，除申請撤回或牌照撤銷／暫時吊銷外，牌照延續至續期或拒絕決定生效。不能套用MSO的2年。
points.en: Grant and renewal normally last three years, with a shorter period possible in a particular case. Apply at least 60 days before expiry. While a timely renewal is pending, the licence continues until renewal or the refusal takes effect, unless the application is withdrawn or licence revoked/suspended. Do not substitute the MSO two-year term.

points.tc: 適當人選審查及最終擁有人／合夥人／董事事前書面批准有獨立條文。無牌經營最高第6級罰款及6個月；第53Z條紀律措施包括公開譴責、補救及最高50萬元罰款，未按時補救另可每日最高1萬元。這些不是MSO第21／43條的罰額。
points.en: Separate provisions govern fitness and propriety and prior written approval of ultimate owners/partners/directors. Unlicensed business carries up to a level 6 fine and six months. Section 53Z discipline includes public reprimand, remediation and a penalty up to HK$500,000, with a further daily penalty up to HK$10,000 for overdue remediation. These are not the MSO section 21/43 ceilings.

title.tc: 參考：第5B部虛擬資產服務
title.en: Reference: Part 5B virtual asset services

points.tc: VA（virtual asset，虛擬資產）的基本定義是加密保護的數碼價值，表述為計算單位或經濟價值儲存形式；具備公眾接受的交易媒介用途，或相關管理／運作／管治的投票權，並可電子轉移、儲存或買賣；另受訂明特徵及指定／排除權規限。央行／政府發行貨幣、有限用途代幣、證券／期貨及儲值支付工具儲值金額／按金等有法定排除，不能把所有數碼資產當同一類。
points.en: VA means virtual asset. The basic definition concerns cryptographically secured digital value expressed as a unit of account or store of economic value, with a public medium-of-exchange use OR relevant management/operation/governance voting rights, and capable of electronic transfer, storage or trading; prescribed characteristics and designation/exclusion powers also apply. Statutory exclusions include central-bank/government-issued currency, limited-purpose tokens, securities/futures and SVF float/deposits. Not all digital assets are the same legal category.

points.tc: 所存附表3B列「經營虛擬資產交易所」：電子設施經常接受／提出買賣要約或介紹交易各方，以形成具約束力交易，並且服務提供者直接或間接管有客戶金錢或虛擬資產。上述交易設施條件與管有條件須同時成立。不得僅因涉及虛擬資產便推定所有服務均是此項；也須考慮第53ZRB條向香港公眾積極推廣的規則。
points.en: Stored Schedule 3B specifies operating a VA exchange: electronic facilities regularly make/accept offers or introduce trading parties in a manner producing binding transactions, AND the provider directly or indirectly possesses client money or VAs. Both the trading-facility and possession conditions matter. VA involvement alone does not make every service this scheduled activity; section 53ZRB active marketing to the Hong Kong public also matters.

points.tc: 證監會發牌；提供者須為《公司條例》所指公司或註冊非香港公司，並符合適當人選及紀錄處所批准等條件。每項服務至少2名獲批負責人員，其中至少1名執行董事、至少1名通常居港；每名屬個人的執行董事均須獲批為負責人員，且任何時間至少1名負責人員可供監督。這些條件須並行符合。
points.en: The SFC licenses providers. A provider must be a Companies Ordinance company or registered non-Hong Kong company and meet fitness, record-premises approval and other conditions. Each service needs at least two approved responsible officers, including at least one executive director and at least one ordinarily resident in Hong Kong; every individual executive director must be approved, and at least one responsible officer must be available at all times to supervise. These are concurrent requirements.

points.tc: 客戶資產有獨立保障；牌照／批准、審計、介入及紀律制度均另有規定。無合理辯解無牌提供服務，循公訴最高500萬元及7年（持續罪行另計）；第53ZSP條紀律罰款上限為1,000萬元或所得利潤／避免損失的3倍，以較高者為準。不要把服務提供者、代表的罪行或MSO規則混用。
points.en: Client assets have separate protection, alongside distinct approval, audit, intervention and disciplinary regimes. Unlicensed provision without reasonable excuse carries, on indictment, up to HK$5 million and seven years, plus a continuing-offence penalty. Section 53ZSP disciplinary penalties can reach the greater of HK$10 million and three times profit gained/loss avoided. Do not mix provider offences with representative offences or MSO rules.

issue: DPMS只列名稱，12萬元可能與CBNI或MSO門檻混淆。
impact: 補A/B分類、相連操作、≥門檻、年期與非香港交易商AND條件；詳細申請行政事項維持參考優先級。

title.tc: 參考：第5C部貴金屬及寶石交易商（DPMS）
title.en: Reference: Part 5C dealers in precious metals and stones (DPMS)

points.tc: DPMS業務包括買賣、進出口、生產／提煉／增值加工貴金屬、寶石、貴重產品，發行／贖回／買賣貴重資產支持工具，以及相關中介活動。物流業者僅在通常業務中代客進出口貨物，不因此單獨成為DPMS。第53ZUA條另豁除政府、認可機構、持牌當押商及符合附屬業務條件的指定金融機構等。
points.en: DPMS business includes trading, import/export, manufacture/refining/value-adding work on precious metals, stones or precious products, issuing/redeeming/trading precious-asset-backed instruments, and related intermediary activity. Ordinary logistics import/export for others alone does not make the operator a DPMS. Section 53ZUA separately excludes government, authorized institutions, licensed pawnbrokers and specified financial institutions satisfying ancillary-business conditions, among others.

points.tc: 海關關長管理A／B類註冊。指明現金交易是在香港支付或收取的現金總額≥120,000港元（或等值外幣）；指明交易是非現金付款總額達同一門檻，而且不屬指明現金交易。均須合併有關連或看來有關連的操作。A類可作指明交易但不可作指明現金交易；B類可作兩者。這是DPMS交易分類，不是跨境CBNI的「>120,000」界線。
points.en: The CCE administers A/B registration. A specified cash transaction involves cash payments made/received in Hong Kong totalling ≥HK$120,000 or foreign-currency equivalent. A specified transaction reaches that threshold in non-cash payments AND is not a specified cash transaction. Aggregate linked or apparently linked operations. Category A covers specified transactions but excludes specified cash transactions; Category B covers both. This DPMS classification differs from the cross-boundary CBNI >HK$120,000 boundary.

points.tc: B類須作適當人選審查；一般有效3年，關長可按個案決定其他期間，續期至少在到期前60日申請。A類設週年費，不能把B類3年期限套給A類。無註冊進行受限制交易或作不實註冊聲稱，最高第6級罰款及6個月。
points.en: Category B requires fitness and propriety assessment; registration normally lasts three years, or another period determined for the particular case, with renewal applied for at least 60 days before expiry. Category A has an annual fee; do not apply the B three-year term to A. Restricted transactions without registration or false holding-out carry up to a level 6 fine and six months.

points.tc: 非香港交易商的特別制度須同時符合：非通常居港個人，或境外設立且非註冊非香港公司／經遷冊公司的法人；在港無營業地點；每公曆年在港經營≤60日。其指明現金交易須盡快向關長報告，無論如何在交易翌日屆滿與相關個人最早離港兩者較早之前；相關個人包括交易時在港的個人交易商及代其交易的個人。此例外不是任何海外客戶均免註冊。
points.en: The special non-Hong Kong dealer regime requires all of these: a non-ordinarily-resident individual, or an overseas-established legal person that is neither a registered non-Hong Kong company nor a re-domiciled company; no Hong Kong place of business; and Hong Kong business on ≤60 days per calendar year. Report specified cash transactions to the CCE as soon as practicable and before the earlier of expiry of the day after the transaction and the earliest departure of a specified individual: the individual dealer present at the transaction or an individual acting for it. This is not a blanket exception for overseas customers.

See the final Part 2 section, Other sector regimes, for applicability; itemised fees and transition procedures whose commencement periods have passed remain source references, not a daily MSO memorisation list.

issue: 第25份其他行業未完成重評，遙距身分與傀儡帳戶、支付功能及2022年提案易被誤讀。
impact: 讀完英文全報告後補共同風險機制、例子與跨版本提示；其餘行業統計及行政沿革保留參考。

title.tc: 2022年報告：跨行業風險如何連到MSO
title.en: 2022 report: how cross-sector risks connect to MSOs

points.tc: 身分真實不等於實際使用者或用途真實。第5.2.13–5.2.17段區分遙距假冒身分風險與招募真人開傀儡戶口；可靠身分技術可減低前者，後者仍須靠客戶背景、控制者及交易行為辨識。傀儡戶口也存在於親身開戶，並非虛擬銀行特有。
points.en: A genuine identity does not prove the real user or purpose. Paragraphs 5.2.13–5.2.17 distinguish remote impersonation from recruiting real people to open stooge accounts. Reliable identity technology can reduce the former; the latter still requires attention to customer background, control and transaction behaviour. Stooge accounts also occur with face-to-face onboarding, not only virtual banks.

points.tc: 多重支付中介可遮蔽最初匯款人及最終受益人；證券第三者付款、代名投資及TCSP成立多層公司，也可能掩蓋實益擁有權／資金來源。理解共同機制，不把「經銀行轉來」「由專業人士介紹」視為資金合法的證明。報告中的他業監管措施並不因此自動變成MSO的同一套法定程序。
points.en: Multiple payment intermediaries can obscure the original payer and ultimate recipient. Securities third-party payments, nominee investments and layered companies formed through TCSPs can also conceal beneficial ownership or source of funds. Understand the shared mechanism: a bank transfer or professional introduction is not proof of lawful funds. Other sectors’ controls in this report do not automatically become identical statutory MSO procedures.

points.tc: 按產品功能看風險：本地小額交通／零售支付與可海外提款、跨境匯款、人對人轉撥的電子錢包，脆弱性不同。報告第5.6節的整體中等評級不能把每種產品或每名客戶都定為同一級，也不能用低額交易自動排除非法博彩或分拆操作。
points.en: Assess product functionality: small domestic transport/retail payments differ from wallets supporting overseas cash withdrawal, cross-border remittance and peer-to-peer transfers. The sector’s medium rating in section 5.6 does not assign every product/customer the same risk, nor do small transactions automatically exclude illegal bookmaking or structuring.

points.tc: 理解例子：虛假投資可以先叫受害人在真實平台買入虛擬資產，再轉到騙徒錢包；也可能只收法幣到傀儡銀行戶口，根本沒有虛擬資產交易。不能只看「加密貨幣投資」名稱或網頁顯示的收益，須理解實際資金流。這是第5.7.5段的2022年案例機制，不是所有虛擬資產活動都屬詐騙。
points.en: Illustration: a fake investment may first send a victim to a genuine platform to buy VAs and then transfer them to a fraudster’s wallet; alternatively, it may collect fiat money into stooge bank accounts without any VA transaction. Understand the actual funds flow rather than relying on the crypto-investment label or displayed returns. This is the 2022 paragraph 5.7.5 typology, not a claim that all VA activity is fraud.

points.tc: 版本分開：第25份在2022年把虛擬資產發牌及DPMS註冊寫為擬議制度；第04份所存2026年綜合條例已載第5B／5C部，Part 2的制度參考以第04份為據。第25份行業數量、風險評級、監管改革與下一步措施均保留2022年時點，不用來判定今天的名單或法律狀態。
points.en: Separate editions: document 25 in 2022 describes VA licensing and DPMS registration as proposed regimes; the stored 2026 consolidated document 04 contains Parts 5B/5C, which support the Part 2 reference notes. Sector counts, risk ratings, regulatory reforms and next steps in document 25 retain their 2022 date and do not establish today’s lists or legal position.

issue: cover payment被譯作「掩蓋付款」，容易把付款機制誤認為隱瞞／洗錢。
impact: 回03第10.3段中英核實，改為官方中文「直接撥付機制」，保留MT202COV例子及適用規則。

title.tc: 戶口號碼、客戶識別號碼、交易參考號碼
title.en: Account number, customer identifier and transaction reference

points.tc: 有相關戶口時用戶口號碼；沒有該戶口，才用由相應匯款機構／收款機構編配、可追查交易的獨特參考號碼。這項先後條件適用於匯款人及收款人的所需資料，不是可任選一個方便的號碼。
points.en: Use the relevant account number when one exists; only without that account use the traceable unique reference assigned by the appropriate ordering/beneficiary institution. This applies to the required information on both originator and recipient, not a free choice of a convenient number.

points.tc: 客戶識別號碼是機構用來唯一識別匯款人的號碼，須指向所存含至少一項以下資料的紀錄：地址、身分證明文件號碼，或出生日期及地點。獨特交易參考號碼用來追查該筆交易；兩者不是同一種號碼。
points.en: A customer identification number uniquely identifies the originator to the institution and points to a record containing at least one of address, identification-document number, or birth date and place. A unique transaction reference traces the transaction; the identifiers serve different purposes.

points.tc: 直接撥付機制（cover payment，例如MT202COV付款）仍須遵守本章適用的電傳要求；這是付款機制名稱，不是「掩蓋付款」或洗錢的同義詞。匯款機構亦須有有效程序防止匯出不合規電傳：合理檢查本地／跨境轉帳的所需雙方資料缺漏、按風險處理缺漏轉帳，並及時修補管控缺失；可包括定期內控／審核測試。
points.en: Cover-payment mechanisms, such as MT202COV payments, remain subject to applicable Chapter 10 wire-transfer requirements. This names a payment mechanism, not concealment or money laundering. Ordering institutions need effective procedures to prevent non-compliant outgoing wires: reasonable checks for missing required information on both sides of domestic/cross-border transfers, risk-based handling and timely control repairs, including appropriate regular control/audit testing.

issue: 公司文件只寫相應成立／周年申報表，不能辨認表格編號及適用公司類型。
impact: 回05第16.1–16.3段核對，參考層補NAR1、NNC1、NNC1G、NN3、NN1的對應及與MSO半年申報的區別。

title.tc: 證明文件按身分及用途準備
title.en: Evidence by legal form and purpose

points.tc: 獨資／合夥提供有效商業登記及商業登記冊資料摘錄。本地公司另備成立證明、最新周年申報表NAR1及其後所有登記文件；新公司用NNC1（股份有限公司）或NNC1G（股份有限公司以外的公司）。非香港公司備非香港公司註冊證明、最新周年申報表NN3及其後存檔文件；新成立公司用NN1（在香港註冊的非香港公司詳情）。另按清單備章程及集團架構／持股比例。這些是公司文件，不是MSO半年交易申報表。
points.en: Proprietors/partnerships provide valid BR and business-register extracts. Local companies add incorporation and the latest annual return NAR1 plus subsequent filings; new companies use NNC1 (limited by shares) or NNC1G (not limited by shares). Non-Hong Kong companies provide their non-Hong Kong-company registration certificate and latest annual return NN3 plus subsequent filings; newly established companies use NN1 (particulars of a non-Hong Kong company registered in Hong Kong). Add constitution and group/ownership structure as listed. These corporate documents are not MSO half-yearly transaction returns.

points.tc: 每個適用處所、LMO及LPS提供已加蓋印花租約／業權、平面圖、內外兩張4R照片及業主准許指定用途信；LMO另備有效商業登記，商住處所另備全體佔用人同意。
points.en: For each applicable premises, LMO and LPS provide stamped tenancy/ownership, floor plan, two interior/exterior 4R photos and owner permission for the relevant use. LMOs add valid BR; mixed premises add every occupant’s consent.

points.tc: 個人伙伴／董事／最終擁有人按居留身分備3A及附錄、香港身分證或旅行證件個人資料頁；法人伙伴／董事按類型備3B及公司文件，境外未在港註冊者的成立證明須按指定規例核證。
points.en: Individual partners/directors/ultimate owners provide Form 3A/appendices and HKID or travel biodata according to residence. Corporate partners/directors provide Form 3B and applicable corporate evidence; overseas corporations unregistered in Hong Kong require certification under the specified regulations.

points.tc: 業務計劃及AML政策須由適用獨資／每名個人伙伴、董事及最終擁有人確認。另按清單備本地／境外第三方合約、CO／MLRO身分證、僱傭合約及申請前3個月內地址證明、銀行戶權證明及銀行確認作金錢服務用途。清單非盡錄，海關可再索資料。
points.en: Plans/policies require applicable proprietor/every individual partner, director and ultimate-owner endorsement. The checklist also covers local/foreign third-party contracts, CO/MLRO HKID/employment and address proof within three months before application, bank ownership and bank acknowledgement of money-service use. Customs may request more; the checklist is not exhaustive.
